//: Assertions under tests/ whose every argument folds to a compile-time constant, and which
are deliberately about arithmetic or about PHP rather than about this repository.
scripts/check-inert-assertions.php fails on any inert assertion absent from this file, so a
test that cannot fail has to be declared deliberately instead of being discovered years
later. It ALSO fails on any entry here that matches nothing, so an exemption cannot outlive
the assertion it excused: fix or delete the assertion and the licence has to go with it.
An entry is a statement that the assertion makes no claim about this repository. It is NOT a
way to stop the gate asking. If the assertion's name describes src/ -- a count of enum cases,
of registry rows, of files -- then the fix is to make a side READ that, not to write a line
here.
The key is the repo-relative file path plus the assertion source with whitespace collapsed,
so it survives the assertion moving lines and stops matching the moment the assertion itself
changes.
MEASURED, 2026-09-21, at 821ba94 + this change: 0 inert out of 1811 assert* call sites across
86 test files, so this map is empty and that is a result rather than an omission. The census
was validated by control before the zero was believed: five planted assertions of the shapes
the TypeScript SDK found (a literal sum against its own total, two local constants summed, a
bare assertTrue(true), a literal array counted, and a local bound to a literal compared to a
sum) were all reported, and four planted assertions that DO read src/ were all silent.
Why the sibling SDK found fifteen here and this one none: the same arithmetic exists in this
repository, but it was written into COMMENTS instead of into assertions -- see
tests/Unit/Enums/OsppErrorCodeTest.php and tests/Contract/Enums/OsppErrorCodeContractTest.php,
where the running sums sit above an assertCount that does read the enum. That moves the defect
out of this gate's reach and into scripts/check-doc-claims.php's, which is where it is caught.
